hook: In a model, line cooling sets where an AGN's warm corona ends, at a sharp iron ionization front.

readout.label: Internal heating at the corona transition

summary: Spectral modeling of a warm corona above an accretion disk shows its outer edge is set where line cooling replaces Compton cooling, at an iron ionization front. A larger corona gives a bigger soft X-ray excess, matching recent changing-look AGN findings. The result comes from a simulated model with fixed assumptions, not from fitting a specific source.
title: The Edge of the Warm Corona in Active Galactic Nuclei
